claims.label: Fort Huachuca Functions as Army Military Intelligence (MIT) Training Installation
claims.claim: Emails received by host state that Fort Huachuca is where U.S. Army soldiers attend advanced Military Intelligence training courses lasting 4–6 months following basic training.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain official DoD documentation confirming Fort Huachuca's current training mission and course catalog.

claims.label: "Mitch" Subject to ~35-Year Gag Order Related to 1990 JTF6 Drug Tunnel Discovery
claims.claim: Witness "Mitch" states he was subject to a non-disclosure / gag order of approximately 25–35 years following his involvement in a 1990 JTF6 (10th Mountain Division) mission that located a major cross-border drug tunnel between Douglas, Arizona and Mexico.
claims.investigative_direction: Review any court filings or legal correspondence referenced by witness; verify his military service record through official channels.

claims.label: "Mitch" Physically Present at Fort Huachuca on September 8–9, 2025
claims.claim: Witness "Mitch" was physically present at Fort Huachuca on the evening of September 8, 2025 (Candlewood Inn & Suites) and the morning of September 9, 2025 (JTF command building), as verified by host via EXIF metadata from an 18-minute self-recorded video and matching military ID credentials.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain original metadata records; verify hotel reservation records and base entry logs for the named date window.

claims.label: "Mitch" Observed Meeting at JTF Building on September 9, 2025 Involving Congressman-Type Figure and Military Officers
claims.claim: While at the JTF command building on the morning of September 9, 2025, witness observed a group including a man in a congressman-style suit with flag pin, accompanied by lieutenant colonels, a sergeant major, and civilians, escorted by military personnel. Witness was subsequently surrounded by multiple federal and local law enforcement officers at a park bench outside.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference Fort Huachuca visitor logs for September 9, 2025; identify Captain Neff and corroborate encounter.

claims.label: "Mitch" Identifies Woman at Candlewood Inn & Suites on September 8, 2025 as Resembling Erika Kirk (95–99% Confidence)
claims.claim: Witness "Mitch" states that a woman he observed at the Candlewood Inn & Suites lobby on September 8, 2025 with striking blue eyes matched reference photographs of Erika Kirk at 95–99% confidence.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain independent corroborating surveillance or visitor logs from Candlewood Inn & Suites for September 8, 2025; verify witness's capacity for facial identification.

claims.label: "Mitch" Identifies Man at JTF Building on September 9, 2025 as Resembling Brian Harpole (95–99% Confidence)
claims.claim: Witness "Mitch" identified by resemblance (95–99%) the man who walked out of the JTF building on September 9, 2025 as Brian Harpole, citing matching mannerisms, facial features, height, haircut, and gait.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify witness's stated capacity for facial recognition; obtain independent surveillance records from Fort Huachuca for September 9, 2025.

claims.label: "Mitch" Identifies Congressman-Type Figure at Fort Huachuca on September 9, 2025 as Mark Amodei (95% Confidence)
claims.claim: After viewing a reference photograph of Congressman Mark Amodei (R-NV) on air, witness "Mitch" identified him at approximately 95% confidence as the congressman-style figure seen walking closest to him at the JTF building on September 9, 2025.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-check Congressman Amodei's official schedule and any flights to Arizona on or around September 9, 2025; obtain independent corroboration.

claims.label: Fort Huachuca Class Taught by Bruce Bevins on Infiltrating Christian Organizations via Covert Psychological Operations
claims.claim: A former gym owner in Sierra Vista states in a viewer email (read verbatim on air) that a distressed female soldier described a class at Fort Huachuca, taught by Bruce Bevins, whose stated objective was to train military personnel to infiltrate Christian groups and organizations through covert psychological operations focused specifically on deceiving Christians.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify Bruce Bevins's official military role and course listings; obtain corroborating testimony from named or additional military students.

claims.label: Fort Huachuca Military Students Described Overnight Deception Training Exercises Against Civilians in Tucson
claims.claim: Per the same viewer email, two military students (names redacted by host) at the gym described an overnight field training mission in which they practiced deceiving civilians in Tucson – telling lies, maintaining false personas, and avoiding "breaking character" – at bars and public venues, with implications of sexual encounters with targets.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the two named students (currently redacted) and obtain independent testimony regarding Fort Huachuca field training practices.

claims.label: Black Plastic / Tempered Glass-Like Fragments Visible in Post-Shooting Photographs of Charlie Kirk's SUV Interior
claims.claim: Host confirms visual observation, prompted by viewer email, of black plastic-like or tempered-glass-like fragments distributed across the rear floor of Charlie Kirk's SUV in post-shooting photographs, noting distinction from surrounding blood.
claims.investigative_direction: Release and forensic-analyze the original high-resolution SUV interior photographs; compare fragments against known materials (phone glass, hard candy, vehicle components).

claims.label: Multiple Federal and Local Law Enforcement Officers Surrounded "Mitch" Outside JTF Building on September 9, 2025
claims.claim: After his identification of personnel exiting the JTF building, witness "Mitch" was escorted to park benches outside by Captain Neff, where multiple cruisers arrived and officers from different agencies surrounded him; a plainclothes woman (described as possibly Secret Service) directed questioning.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain any contemporaneous bodycam footage or police reports; identify the plainclothes officer and any incident reports generated September 9, 2025.

claims.label: Flood of law-enforcement and military emails objecting to the bomb-dog account
claims.claim: The host says that the previous day she received a flood of emails from law enforcement officers and military personnel who rejected the account that the bomb dogs missed the gun.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask the host to publish or characterize a sample of the emails and confirm whether the senders have bomb-dog (K-9) handler credentials.
claims.transcript_snippet: I received a flood of emails from law enforcement officers, military guys that were just like

claims.label: Host cautions SUV fragments do not prove rigging
claims.claim: The host says the fragments in the SUV photos cannot be extrapolated into evidence that something broke on Charlie Kirk or was rigged, and that mundane explanations such as a broken phone are possible.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare the original high-resolution SUV photographs against reference images of phone glass, hard candy and vehicle trim.
claims.transcript_snippet: And I want to say that we can't necessarily extrapolate that from what we're looking at. It could be a thousand other things.

claims.label: Host withholding remaining SUV photos to protect federal sources
claims.claim: The host says she is hesitant to release the rest of the SUV photographs because she does not want the federal officers who assisted her to be identified and fired.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask the host which photographs remain unreleased and what provenance chain protects her sources.
claims.transcript_snippet: I am hesitant, by the way, to put up the rest of the photos. Kind of still going through that.

claims.label: Host says there is no evidence against Tyler Robinson beyond untimestamped messages
claims.claim: The host says there is no evidence against Tyler Robinson outside of messages that are not timestamped, and that there is no confession.
claims.investigative_direction: Review the Utah charging documents and any public filings for the evidence list and the status of any confession.
claims.transcript_snippet: There's no evidence outside of these shady messages that are not even timestamped. He We don't have a confession from him.

claims.label: Surgeon never confirmed a .30-06 or a steel neck
claims.claim: The host says the surgeon never confirmed or suggested that Charlie Kirk was shot with a .30-06 or that a steel neck stopped the bullet, and that he suggested a frangible bullet may have been used.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the surgeon's own public statements or interview record and compare them with the host's account and with the medical examiner's findings.
claims.transcript_snippet: The surgeon never confirmed or even suggested that Charlie was shot with a.30-06 or that Charlie had a steel neck that stopped that bullet.

claims.label: Lone rooftop eyewitness not contacted by lawyers or investigators
claims.claim: The host says the lone confirmed eyewitness who saw the alleged shooter on the Lozi Center rooftop before the shot has not been contacted by the lawyers or investigators on either side, even though the investigation phase before the May probable cause hearing is under way.
claims.investigative_direction: Check court filings and defense and prosecution witness lists for the eyewitness, and ask the witness whether any investigator has made contact.
claims.transcript_snippet: has not been contacted by the lawyers or the investigators on either side of this trial

claims.label: Rooftop eyewitness, a gun-range instructor, says the weapon looked like a .223
claims.claim: The host says the rooftop eyewitness is an instructor at a gun range who described the weapon he saw as looking more like a .223 and shorter than the one that was found.
claims.investigative_direction: Interview the witness on the record, confirm his instructor credentials and compare his description with the recovered rifle's measurements.
claims.transcript_snippet: this individual is an instructor at a gun range. He claims the weapon that he saw looked more like a.223.

claims.label: Rooftop figure wore black tactical gear and a face mask and looked professional
claims.claim: The host says the rooftop eyewitness described the person he saw as wearing what seemed to be black tactical gear plus a face mask, and as looking like a professional.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare the eyewitness's description with the clothing seen in surveillance and doorbell footage of the shooter.
claims.transcript_snippet: wearing what seemed to him to be black tactical gear plus a face mask, and he describes that person as looking like a like a professional

claims.label: Bomb dogs were unable to find the weapon in the field where it was found
claims.claim: The host says the bomb dogs were unable to locate the weapon in the field where it was eventually discovered, although they had crawled over that area.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain K-9 deployment logs and incident reports for the search area and confirm the dogs' search pattern and timing.
claims.transcript_snippet: The bomb dogs were unable to locate the weapon in the field where it was eventually discovered despite the fact that they had crawled over that area.

claims.label: Federal agents directed local officers to the weapon
claims.claim: The host says that, rather than the dogs finding it, federal agents directed local officers to the weapon.
claims.investigative_direction: Request the recovery report, officer statements and evidence logs identifying who found the weapon and who directed the search.
claims.transcript_snippet: Instead, what happened was federal agents directed local officers to the weapon.

claims.label: Dogs were not given the weapon's scent to trace it back to the roof
claims.claim: The host says the canines were not provided with the scent of the weapon once it was discovered, so the dogs did not trace it back to the top of the Lozi Center.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask the investigating agencies whether any scent-trail work was attempted from the weapon location to the roof and obtain the K-9 records.
claims.transcript_snippet: The canines were not provided with the scent of the weapon once it was discovered.

claims.label: Terrell Farnsworth raced to remove the camera behind Charlie's head
claims.claim: The host says Terrell Farnsworth raced to remove the camera that was directly behind Charlie Kirk's head, and that major question marks remain about it.
claims.investigative_direction: Review event footage and statements from Farnsworth on when and why the camera was removed, and the chain of custody of its storage.
claims.transcript_snippet: Terrell Farnsworth, still major question marks. He raced to remove the camera that was directly behind Charlie's head.

claims.label: Host's reading of why the camera was removed
claims.claim: The host says that, in her own reading and not as a data point, the camera was removed because the story was going to be that a .30-06 hit Charlie Kirk, and the footage would have shown there was no tremendous damage to his neck.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the camera's retained footage and compare it with the medical findings; ask Farnsworth for his stated reason.
claims.transcript_snippet: when I imagine why he might have done that, I think it's because they were going to go with this story that a.30-06 hit Charlie Kirk.

claims.label: Federal agents prevented the surgeon from returning to the operating room
claims.claim: The host says federal agents prevented the surgeon from returning to his operating room, which startled him, and that he placed a call presumably to DC because he wanted the team back in to clean Charlie Kirk before Erika Kirk came in.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the surgeon and hospital staff who could confirm the exclusion, and obtain hospital records of restricted access that morning.
claims.transcript_snippet: federal agents prevented the surgeon from returning to his operating room.

claims.label: Federal agents removed the hospital surveillance footage
claims.claim: The host says federal agents removed the hospital surveillance footage.
claims.investigative_direction: Request the hospital's records of any footage seizure or release to federal authorities.
claims.transcript_snippet: Federal agents removed the hospital surveillance footage.

claims.label: Vehicle that took Charlie to the hospital was not impounded
claims.claim: The host says the vehicle in which Charlie Kirk was transported to Timpanogos Hospital was not impounded by law enforcement.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain evidence-hold and impound records for the transport vehicle and its return to its owner.
claims.transcript_snippet: the vehicle in which Charlie was transported to Timpanogos or Timpanogos Hospital was not impounded by law enforcement.

claims.label: Host confirms multiple sets of prints on the recovered weapon
claims.claim: The host says she can confirm there were multiple sets of prints on the recovered gun, not only those of Tyler Robinson.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the latent-print and DNA reports filed by the Utah crime lab for the recovered rifle.
claims.transcript_snippet: There were multiple sets of prints that were on the gun that was recovered thanks to the instincts of the feds and not the noses of the dogs.

claims.label: Footage of Tyler Robinson turning himself in is apparently missing
claims.claim: The host says the footage of Tyler Robinson turning himself in is apparently missing.
claims.investigative_direction: File a records request for the station and sheriff's office surrender footage and the log of who viewed or copied it.
claims.transcript_snippet: the footage of Tyler Robinson turning himself in is apparently missing.

claims.label: Local Utah news told the surrender footage had expired
claims.claim: The host says that local Utah news requested the surrender footage and was told the footage had expired and the agency no longer has it, although she allows they may mean it was handed to investigators.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the Utah outlet and the records request, and obtain the agency's written denial and retention policy.
claims.transcript_snippet: There's been an expiration on that footage and we don't have it.

claims.label: Host says the parents-turned-him-in story is false
claims.claim: The host says her investigation found that the story that Tyler Robinson's parents turned him in and did the right thing is false.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare the host's sources with the public account from the sheriff's office and the family's attorney, and any recorded 911 or intake logs.
claims.transcript_snippet: in my investigation, I found that their entire story about how the parents turned him in and did the right thing is crap.

claims.label: Host says Robinson was told to come in peacefully or doors would be broken down
claims.claim: The host says that, according to her investigation, Tyler Robinson and his parents were told either the doors would be broken down or he would come in peacefully, and he chose the latter.
claims.investigative_direction: Seek the sheriff's operational plan and communications for the surrender, and statements from the family's representatives.
claims.transcript_snippet: They were told either, you know, these doors are going to get broken down or you're going to you're going to come in peacefully.

claims.label: Police officers say they were told not to look at him and to avoid cameras
claims.claim: The host says police officers who were present when Tyler Robinson came in told her they were told not to look at him and to avoid cameras.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify officers present at intake and obtain any written directive on camera avoidance during the surrender.
claims.transcript_snippet: told not to look at him. They were told to avoid cameras.

claims.label: Host says Calvary Chapel installs former pedophiles and drug traffickers as lead pastors
claims.claim: The host says that within Calvary Chapel in particular there is too much of a habit of establishing former pedophiles and drug traffickers as lead pastors of churches.
claims.investigative_direction: List the specific Calvary Chapel pastors the host has named in earlier episodes and check court and sentencing records for each.
claims.transcript_snippet: there's just way too much of a habit of establishing former pedophiles and drug traffickers as lead pastors of churches.

claims.label: Rob McCoy interview with a man who went to prison and was given access to children
claims.claim: The host says Rob McCoy interviewed a man who went to prison after a rampage, helped launder his reputation and then gave him access to children again.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the interview the host refers to and identify the man, his conviction and his later church role.
claims.transcript_snippet: He actually went to prison for it and he was just sort of laundering his reputation and then gave him access again uh to children.

claims.label: Host says many conservative media companies are run by former military intelligence
claims.claim: The host says there are many conservative media companies run by former military intelligence, naval intelligence or Mossad personnel who then speak about Judeo-Christian values.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask the host to name the companies and executives, then check public biographies for intelligence service.
claims.transcript_snippet: Similarly, there are so many conservative media companies who are run by former military intelligence. People that leave naval intelligence, people that leave the Mossad.

claims.label: Host says she has argued that faith has been infiltrated by the military
claims.claim: The host says she has been suggesting that faith has been infiltrated by the military and that people laughed.
claims.investigative_direction: Compile the host's earlier statements on military infiltration of faith groups and the specific organizations named.
claims.transcript_snippet: I have been suggesting to you all that faith has been infiltrated by the military and people laughed.

claims.label: Host describes Fort Huachuca as an intelligence training hub where civilians can become assets
claims.claim: The host says Fort Huachuca is a hub for intelligence training where civilians can be turned into intelligence assets and take courses to join the intelligence community.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain Fort Huachuca's published mission and course catalog and any program open to civilians.
claims.transcript_snippet: Civilians can be turned into intelligence assets on this base. They can take courses to join the intelligence community

claims.label: Email: two recently baptized Christians started a gym near Fort Huachuca in May 2013
claims.claim: The host paraphrases an emailer who says their story begins in May 2013, when two recently baptized Christians in Sierra Vista put their savings into starting a gym whose clientele included people associated with the base.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the gym owners and the gym, and confirm the business's founding date through Arizona corporate records.
claims.transcript_snippet: their story begins in May of 2013. They are two recently baptized Christians.

claims.label: Email: a founding-member couple allegedly staged a hostile takeover of the gym
claims.claim: According to the emailer as relayed by the host, a couple who invested in the gym and became founding members allegedly staged a hostile takeover of the company, and the owners almost lost everything and had to downsize.
claims.investigative_direction: Check Arizona Corporation Commission filings and any civil court records involving the gym and the investing couple.
claims.transcript_snippet: this couple over time effectively staged something akin to a hostile takeover of their company.

claims.label: Email: a distressed soldier called Bruce Bevins the most evil man she had met
claims.claim: According to the emailer, the distressed female soldier described Bruce Bevins as the most evil man she had ever met.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the soldier and Bevins's official role, and corroborate through an on-record account from the soldier.
claims.transcript_snippet: This young woman described Bruce as, quote, "the most evil man that she had ever met."

claims.label: Email: writer recalled an incident with Bevins's wife
claims.claim: According to the emailer, hearing the name Bruce Bevins, the writer immediately remembered an incident involving Bevins's wife.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask the emailer to describe the incident with Bevins's wife and look for police or court records of it.
claims.transcript_snippet: My ears perked up when I heard his name as I immediately remembered the incident with his wife.

claims.label: Email: writer wonders whether the gym's destruction was a training exercise
claims.claim: According to the emailer, the writer wonders whether the infiltration and destruction of the gym was a training exercise or field assignment, and whether the distressed soldier was sent to the gym on assignment from Bevins.
claims.investigative_direction: Treat as the emailer's speculation; seek documentary evidence linking the couple to any Fort Huachuca course.
claims.transcript_snippet: I have to wonder if the infiltration and the destruction of our gym was actually a training exercise or field assignment.

claims.label: Email: some of Charlie's trusted people may have been trained operatives who infiltrated TPUSA
claims.claim: According to the emailer, the writer is now wondering whether instructors like Bruce Bevins trained some individuals before they infiltrated Christian organizations like Turning Point USA, in light of reports that some of Charlie Kirk's most trusted people may have been trained operatives.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask the emailer which TPUSA individuals they have in mind and check those individuals' public military or intelligence records.
claims.transcript_snippet: learning that some of his most trusted people may have been trained operatives who infiltrated Turning Point USA

claims.label: Host cannot confirm the Bevins allegations and has never heard of him
claims.claim: The host says she cannot yet confirm the allegations against Bruce Bevins and has never heard of him, while saying she expects more emails after the show.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify Bevins's identity and role through Army and Fort Huachuca records before treating the email as corroborated.
claims.transcript_snippet: Now, I obviously cannot confirm just yet. I'm sure after this show, we're going to get a bunch of emails.

claims.label: Host says all roads lead to the front door of Turning Point USA Faith
claims.claim: The host says she has been telling viewers that all roads, including the Egyptian and Israeli planes, lead to the front door of Turning Point USA Faith, and that she feels the email is a big piece of the puzzle.
claims.investigative_direction: List the specific planes, people and TPUSA Faith links the host relies on and document each.
claims.transcript_snippet: I keep telling you that all roads, including the Egyptian here Israeli uh planes lead to the front door of Turning Point USA Faith.

claims.label: Host asks former Fort Huachuca course participants to email moretips
claims.claim: The host asks anyone who took part in the alleged Christian-infiltration exercises at Fort Huachuca and has second thoughts to email her off the record at moretips@candaceowens.com.
claims.investigative_direction: Record any tips received through the address and their provenance; verify any claimed course participation with service records.
claims.transcript_snippet: please email moretips@candaceowens. com.

claims.label: Host says wall-to-wall panic followed mention of Fort Huachuca
claims.claim: The host says that since she mentioned Fort Huachuca and the alleged September 9 meeting there has been wall-to-wall panic, with unhinged articles.
claims.investigative_direction: Collect the articles and statements published after the host's first Fort Huachuca mention and note any factual claims in them.
claims.transcript_snippet: we suddenly have been experiencing wall-to-wall panic ever since we mentioned Fort Huachuca.

claims.label: Tucker Carlson asked where a man's money comes from at the TPUSA event
claims.claim: The host says Tucker Carlson asked at the Turning Point USA event the question "Where does this guy's money come from?"
